canonicalPrompt.text:
Create exactly one full-body Summonlab combat chibi derived only from the supplied verified summon portrait. Canvas 1024 x 1536. Keep the character an adult and unmistakably the exact same person; simplify shapes for a clean painterly combat-game chibi. PROPORTION LOCK: the complete head-and-hair unit occupies 32 to 36 percent of the standing figure height, producing 2.75 to 3.1 heads total. Use a clearly oversized adult head, compact torso, and shortened legs; never render a 3.5-head, 4-head, or tall-miniature figure. Preserve relative body widths without generic inflation of the body. Use a grounded ready-idle three-quarter pose, both empty hands and both feet completely visible, with a generous safe margin and a warm pale parchment studio wash.

Identity continuity: Rael Quoran, age 36, gender presentation man, skin-value band 2; round full face; large hooded eyes and a broken brow line; small upturned nose, heavy lower lip; one cheek mole Preserve adult age cues, face geometry, skin, and expression; use a calm closed mouth with no smile or theatrical acting. Enlarge the cranium for chibi scale without replacing the source eye shape, eye spacing, brow structure, nose, mouth, jaw, or cheek planes with a shared generic doll-face template; the roster must retain visibly different adult faces at combat scale. Body continuity: clearly-muscular, medium; 170 cm; clearly muscular construction with readable shoulders, back, legs, and forearms. Preserve shoulder and torso width, mass, softness, muscle distribution, upper-arm and forearm girth, wrist scale, hand size, leg mass, and posture. Do not make the arms, hands, shoulders, torso, or body fatter or bulkier merely because this is chibi. Tall or slight identity must read through shape and posture without shrinking the head below the required chibi ratio.

Hair continuity: red-copper-auburn long-loose; accent: none. Preserve the front and side silhouette of long-loose, the parting, gathered mass, shaved areas, and none; color remains red-copper-auburn. Wardrobe continuity: mantle-short-cape in plum-gray; a small mantle or short cape over an unarmored tunic and divided lower layers; a high soft collar and uneven layered hems. Condition: immaculate clothes over weathered hands. Preserve every visible seam, repair, closure, accessory, tattoo, marking, and palette relationship that survives at chibi scale. Personal anchors: three hair rings. Add nothing new.
